rca of the issue: Previously fixed. Root cause was two-fold: (1) server.py franchise_my_visible_pages short-circuited to full catalog for any admin, ignoring impersonate_mess_id; (2) AdminLayout.jsx only fetched visible-pages when role==='mess_owner'.
